ARMY.Title: Army Tracker
ARMY.DayTooltip: Days elapsed since the campaign began
ARMY.AdvanceDayConfirm: Advance to day {day}? Every roster member will receive their daily pay — debts are paid down first, and the remainder goes into their camp vault stash.
ARMY.AdvancedNotice: Advanced to day {day}. Pay has been distributed.
ARMY.AdvanceDaysPrompt: How many days should pass? Pay is applied for each day in sequence — debts are paid down first, and the remainder goes into each member's camp vault.
ARMY.AdvancedNoticeMulti: Advanced {days} days to day {day}. Pay has been distributed.
ARMY.WageOverrideTooltip: Override the daily wage. Leave blank to use the rank's default (shown greyed out).
ARMY.LoanPrompt: How much to loan? Up to {available} {currency} remains available (loans are capped at six months' base salary by default).
ARMY.LoanMaxed: This member has already borrowed up to their loan limit.
ARMY.RepayDebtTooltip: Move money from this member's camp vault stash to pay down their debt.
ARMY.NothingToRepay: Nothing to repay — either there is no debt or the vault is empty.

Transfer.depositTooltip: Move coin from this character's inventory into the camp vault.
Transfer.withdrawTooltip: Take coin out of the camp vault and back into this character's inventory.
Transfer.depositPrompt: How much should be moved from this character's purse into the camp vault?
Transfer.withdrawPrompt: How much should be taken out of the camp vault and handed back to the character?
Transfer.ledgerOnly: No linked character inventory — this will only adjust the vault ledger. Move the coin on the character sheet yourself.
Transfer.EmptyVault: There is nothing in this member's vault to withdraw.
Transfer.NoCoin: This character isn't carrying any coin to deposit.
Transfer.Insufficient: This character isn't carrying enough coin to cover that deposit.
Transfer.VaultShort: The vault doesn't hold that much.
Transfer.NoMember: That roster member no longer exists.
Transfer.NoUser: Could not identify the requesting user.
Transfer.NotOwner: You can only move money for a character you own.
Transfer.BadAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
Transfer.Failed: The transfer could not be completed.

ARMY.RemoveConfirm: Remove {name} from the roster? Their pay, debt and vault records will be deleted.
ARMY.RosterEmpty: No party members on the roster yet. Add your soldiers to begin tracking their pay.
ARMY.RosterEmptyWarn: The roster is empty — add party members before advancing the day.

Unit.strengthTooltip: Soldiers within this unit, counting every squad beneath it.
Unit.notesPh: Campaign notes, standing orders, anything worth keeping at army level…

ARMY.StructureHint: The army runs from the top down: Army → Host → Company → Cohort → Squad. Units start collapsed — open one with the chevron to name it and record who serves in it. Everyone at the table can fill this in.
ARMY.UnitEmpty: Nothing here yet — use the + button on the header above to add a sub-unit.
ARMY.SquadEmpty: No soldiers recorded in this squad yet — use the + button to add one.
ARMY.NoGM: No GM is connected — your changes cannot be saved right now.

Payday.speaker: Army Paymaster
Payday.name: Name
Payday.empty: No troops on the roster — nobody to pay.

daysPerWeek.name: Days per Week
daysPerWeek.hint: Used to calculate the weekly salary shown in the roster.

daysPerMonth.name: Days per Month
daysPerMonth.hint: Used to calculate the monthly salary and the loan cap.

daysPerYear.name: Days per Year
daysPerYear.hint: Used to calculate the yearly salary shown in the roster.

loanMonths.name: Loan Cap (months of salary)
loanMonths.hint: Members may borrow up to this many months of their base salary.

currency.name: Currency Label
currency.hint: Shown next to all monetary amounts, e.g. gp, sp, denarii. On Pathfinder 2e, vault balances are treated as gold pieces when depositing or withdrawing coin.

ARMY.SquadImplied: No soldiers named yet — mustering at the configured squad size of {count}.

Generate.title: Generate Army Structure
Generate.summary: This will build {hosts} hosts, each of {companies} companies, each of {cohorts} cohorts, each of {squads} squads of {soldiers} soldiers.
Generate.overwrite: This replaces the existing army structure. The army's own name and notes are kept.
Generate.done: Army generated — {count} soldiers in the field.

Config.title: Configure Army Tracker
Config.menuHint: Edit ranks and their daily pay, the deductions new recruits start with, officer titles, and army generation.
Config.ranksHint: Ranks appear in the roster dropdown in this order. The wage is the default daily pay; individual members can override it.
Config.needOneRank: At least one named rank is required.
Config.rankInUse: {count} roster member(s) currently hold {label}. They will show as a removed rank until you reassign them. Remove it anyway?
Config.deductionsHint: Deduction lines given to each newly added roster member. Existing members are not changed.
Config.noDeductions: New recruits will start with no deductions.
Config.officersHint: Gives every unit an officer slot, and the army a commander above host level. These titles are used when generating the army; you can retitle any officer afterwards.
Config.generateHint: Sets how many of each sub-unit the generator creates. Units are named by position — 1st Squad, 2nd Squad, and so on.
Config.generateWhere: Save, then use Generate Army on the Army Structure tab.

ARMY.ExpandAllTooltip: Open every unit in the army.
ARMY.CollapseAllTooltip: Close every unit, including the army itself.
ARMY.PrimaryOfficerTooltip: Commanding officer of this unit — the first in its officer list.
ARMY.LevelTooltip: The army's level. On Pathfinder 2e this sets the ceiling for the shop browser.

Shop.tooltip: Browse common equipment up to the army's level
Shop.unavailable: The Pathfinder 2e compendium browser isn't available in this world.
Shop.failed: Could not open the compendium browser.
Shop.unfiltered: Compendium browser opened, but the level and rarity filters could not be applied — filter to common items up to level {level} yourself.

Bonus.tooltip: Pay a bonus to every member of the roster.
Bonus.title: Grant Party Bonus
Bonus.prompt: Pay a bonus to everyone on the roster. It goes straight into each member's camp vault.
Bonus.modeFlat: Flat amount — the same for everyone
Bonus.modeWeek: One week's pay ({days} days) — varies per member
Bonus.modeMonth: One month's pay ({days} days) — varies per member
Bonus.debtFirst: Pay down outstanding debt first, banking only the remainder
Bonus.basis: Week and month bonuses are based on each member's base wage before deductions, so living costs don't eat into the reward.
Bonus.needAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero for a flat bonus.
